remarks: Set on beautifully landscaped grounds just minutes from downtown Glenville, this charming residence blends timeless historic character with modern conveniences. The home features 4 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, spacious living areas filled with natural light, and a thoughtfully designed layout ideal for everyday living and entertaining. Enjoy the beauty of the surrounding grounds from multiple outdoor spaces, creating a true private retreat just moments from shopping, dining, parks, and transportation. Additional highlights include 1st Floor bedroom option with bath, 972SF third floor with half bath perfect for guest space, art studio or playroom. EV Charger, ample parking, and the rare combination of historic charm and modern functionality in one of Greenwich's most desirable locations.
